Benchmark methodology & public datasets

This is a synthetic support regression suite, not a public leaderboard. It tests repeatable failure modes against a fixed corpus. The public datasets below have not been imported or evaluated here.

EACL 2026

T²-RAGBench ↗

Text, tables and numerical reasoning in financial reports.

LREC 2026

LIT-RAGBench ↗

Integration, reasoning, logic, tables and abstention.

ESTABLISHED

RAGBench ↗

Broader labelled examples for relevance, support and completeness.

Sources checked 10 September 2026. Each public dataset needs a versioned import and its own scoring protocol.
